The source execution_complete check accepts exit33/output length/prefix/suffix. This independent review additionally decodes all16 middle bytes and validates trace ordering; execution_complete alone is insufficient.
Trace collection is address-filtered and not a universal whole-system event history. Firmware events are present; absence of arbitrary unlogged activity cannot be inferred.
No complete finalRAM/CPU snapshot was captured. ELF identity and traced writes establish this small path; they do not establish arbitrary self-modifying-code or mutable-memory equivalence.
The debugcon dump is instrumentation in a self-owned handler. It is not a permitted rewrite of an original protected program and does not prove unchanged timing or original resource lifetime.
Exception instruction not-retired cases must remain distinct from completed predecessors. An isolated TB-entry PC or two adjacentPCs is never enough.
TCG modeled execution cannot validate VMware/WHP hardware transparency. Earlier QEMU full57 rejection remains in force, and exact publisher-fork source/compiled-binary closure is absent.
